name: Bezer
overview: Bezer is a male figure from the tribe of Asher, uniquely identified as the son of Zophah according to 1 Chronicles 7:37. Beyond this paternal connection, the biblical record provides no additional details about his life or role. His mention serves primarily to establish genealogical lineage within the tribe of Asher.
namesAndTitles: The name Bezer is a proper name and is understood to mean either 'metallic ore' or 'place of refuge.' This meaning highlights a possible symbolic significance of strength or safety, though the name itself was not given directly by God, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:37.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Bezer's family relationship explicitly as the son of Zophah. No other familial ties or relationships are documented beyond this paternal link in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Bezer's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, as presented in 1 Chronicles 7:37. His mention contributes to the broader biblical effort to trace the descendants of Israel's tribes, which is important for understanding the fulfillment of God's promises to His people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion affirms the continuity of God's covenant through successive generations.
